## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3893 (spec 0.3917), screen at the exact 128:160 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://www.newmobile.com/phones/sony/ericsson-w205 (press render 200904_w205_front_open_ambient_black; reflection cropped off)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://www.newmobile.com/phones/sony/ericsson-w205); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/w205/).
